name: Nam Taeng Mo
description: Fresh watermelon juice blended smooth and poured over ice, vibrantly pink and naturally sweet.
ingredients: a handful of fresh Thai basil, chopped
a generous spoonful of tamarind paste
instructions: Combine the jasmine rice and tamarind water in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the ground turmeric and coconut cream, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with fish sauce, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with mint just before serving.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
